# Typography

## Heading

`import { Heading } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

A heading that is not a card's, a dialog's or a page's: those have `CardTitle`, `DialogTitle` and `PageHeader`. This is a section inside a page body, so the face, the weight and the step come from one place. A figure is not a heading.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `as` | `'h1' \| 'h2' \| 'h3' \| 'h4' \| 'h5' \| 'h6'` | `'h2'` | The level, for the document outline. `h2` by default; a page's `h1` is `PageHeader`'s. Choose it by where the heading sits, never by how big it should look; that is `size`. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | `sm` 16px (a card's title), `md` 18px (a dialog's), `lg` 20px (a section opening a page body). |

Also takes: every `<h1>`–`<h6>` attribute.

## Text

`import { Text } from '@jovertical/mise-design-system'`

Body text, set by what it is doing rather than by the classes that draw it: the size, the muting, the weight, the figures, and nothing else. No face, no arbitrary size, no colour outside `muted` and the shared `Tone`. `as` rather than `asChild`, because the element is the one semantic choice text makes.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `as` | `'span' \| 'p' \| 'div'` | `'span'` | `span` by default; `p` for a sentence that stands as a paragraph, `div` for text holding a block. |
| `size` | `'xs' \| 'sm'` |  | `xs` 12px, `sm` 14px. Omit it to inherit the line's size. A larger step is a heading. |
| `muted` | `boolean` | `false` | De-emphasis, `text-muted-foreground`: a hint, a timestamp. Not a status. |
| `tone` | `'neutral' \| 'primary' \| 'info' \| 'success' \| 'warning' \| 'critical'` |  | Status ink, for text that carries a state. Wins over `muted`. |
| `weight` | `'normal' \| 'medium' \| 'semibold'` |  | `medium` for a name or a value, `semibold` for a total, `normal` to undo an inherited weight. |
| `numeric` | `boolean` | `false` | `tabular-nums`, so a column of figures lines up. |
| `truncate` | `boolean` | `false` | One line, ellipsised. Needs a width to truncate against. |

Also takes: every HTML attribute.

Types: `TextSize` (`'xs' | 'sm'`), `TextWeight` (`'normal' | 'medium' | 'semibold'`).
